review.notes: Chain starts at v1 (LOD-EN028 / Master Collection Volume 1), the text the GOAT variant carries exactly. v0->v1 ('Move'->'Add', shuffle wording), v1->v2 (HL06-EN004, 2008-04, drops 'Then shuffle your Deck') and v2->v3 (LEDD-ENA27, 2017, 'Warrior-Type'->'Warrior') are cosmetic and are not recorded as changes. This card is the shared brief's named counter-example, so the shared 'search-verification' chronology (old state attested through 2011-02-02) is deliberately NOT used: its activation allowance demonstrably ended earlier. I dated the change from the two archived official captures instead, which is a determinate result for both target eras - GOAT (2005-04-01) precedes 2005-06-16 and so uses the historical implementation; Edison (2010-04-24) follows 2008-12-15 and so uses the modern card. Residual not modelled as a version: between 2008-12-15 and the end of the general verification procedure, a whiff forced by a chain (rather than by a deliberately empty search) would presumably still have been verifiable; that intermediate state has no upstream implementation and no practical effect on play, so it is documented here rather than recorded as a version with a gap. Source id 'ude-card-rulings-archive' is the registered id in data/sources.json covering both the 2005 UDE rulings pages and the 2008-12-15 Card FAQ capture.

effective.basis: Per-card ruling chronology from two archived official documents: the UDE Card Rulings capture of 2005-06-16 expressly permits activation with no valid Warrior left in the Deck subject to Deck verification; Konami's yugioh-card.com Card FAQ capture of 2008-12-15 expressly forbids activation without one.

corroboration.quote: You can activate this card even if you have no Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monsters remaining in your Deck, but you must let your opponent see your Deck to confirm.
You cannot activate "Reinforcement of the Army" if you do not have any Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monsters remaining in your Deck.

event.historical_text: Add 1 Level 4 or lower Warrior-Type monster from your Deck to your hand. Then shuffle your Deck.
event.summary: Period procedure plus a per-card activation ruling, not a text erratum: the GOAT script reduces s.target to `if chk==0 then return true end` (the modern Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard check over LOCATION_DECK is gone), so the card can be activated with no Level 4 or lower Warrior left in the Deck, and it proves the failed search by revealing the Deck (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script requires a valid target to activate and never reveals. The printed text is behaviourally identical across the whole English lineage.
